review_notes: Read the whole file and the definition of mul_pred_dvd_card and card_eq_card_projectiveImage_mul. Found one repeated argument (2-transitive action on a set of size ≥ 2 forces n(n-1) | |group|, hence even group order, contradicting odd order). Other candidate repetitions (finrank pos/omega steps, Submodule.span_induction closure) are short or occur once. I did not check how the same pattern appears in sibling files beyond the grep hits for card_eq_card_projectiveImage_mul. The proposed helper is untested.

findings.problem: The proof twice carries out the same argument. A 2-transitive action on a set Ω with 2 ≤ |Ω| gives |Ω|(|Ω|-1) ∣ |H| by mul_pred_dvd_card. Since |Ω|(|Ω|-1) is even, 2 divides |H|, and |H| divides |G|, so |G| is even. That contradicts `Odd (Nat.card G)`. The argument appears once for projectiveImage G acting on ℙ k F (lines 70–79) and again for M.permK acting on M.Δ (lines 87–96). Each copy rebuilds the divisibility chain and ends with the same `Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hodd` / `even_iff_two_dvd` step. The first copy also uses a separate hev argument from hPodd, which is unnecessary because n(n-1) is always even.
findings.proposed_change: Add a helper next to mul_pred_dvd_card in SingerProjectiveImage.lean. Its statement would be `theorem two_dvd_card_of_isMultiplyPretransitive_two {H Ω : Type*} [Group H] [MulAction H Ω] [Finite Ω] (h2 : IsMultiplyPretransitive H Ω 2) (hΩ : 2 ≤ Nat.card Ω) : 2 ∣ Nat.card H`. The proof is `(Nat.even_mul_pred_self _).two_dvd.trans (mul_pred_dvd_card h2 hΩ)`. In the first branch, use `exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hodd) (even_iff_two_dvd.mpr ((two_dvd_card_of_isMultiplyPretransitive_two h2 hP2).trans (Dvd.intro _ hGcard.symm)))`. This also removes hev and the hPodd destructuring. In the second branch, use the same lemma with hΔ and then `.trans (h1.trans h3)`. The odd-order contradiction could also be factored as `Odd (Nat.card G) → ¬ 2 ∣ Nat.card G`. Both branches would then shrink to the one divisibility chain that differs, and the parity argument would live in one place.
findings.benefit: The shared parity argument is stated and proved once, and the first branch no longer depends on hPodd for its evenness step. Each branch then shows only the group-specific divisibility link (projectiveImage or permK), which makes normalizes_of_odd easier to read. The lemma is also reusable by other 2-transitive/odd-order arguments in the Singer files.
